d._instruction: Rinse the foam off with the shower.
Pick a lip gloss for her.
Spread the gel mask over her face.
Paint the gloss on her lips.
Peel the gel mask off her face.
Take the face wash to her face.
Dab the mask on through the stencil.
Peel the stencil off her face.
Scrub the foam all over her face.
Drag the headband onto her head.

320.n: 1 - Cut the vines off her face

d._instruction: Cut the vines away with the scissors.
Spread the cream over her scars.
A line of glue on each lash.
Spray the dried mud off her face.
Wipe the wet mud off with a tissue.
Brush the shade over her eyelids.
Drag an eyelash to her eye.
